terminal.summary: Jim Fleax is a highly skilled full-stack developer specializing in building sleek, high-performance web applications with modern technologies like React, Next.js, Python, and MongoDB. Known for his pixel-perfect frontend aesthetics and robust backend architecture, he is passionate about creating seamless digital experiences.

about.paragraph:
Hi there! I'm Reetabrata Bhandari—better known as Jim Fleax! 👋 I’m passionate about exploring computer languages and crafting innovative apps and websites. My goal is to create sleek, delicious interfaces that seamlessly blend with powerful logic and robust backends, resulting in responsive apps designed to make life simpler and more enjoyable. 👨💻✨

Beyond coding, I find joy in losing myself in fiction 📚️, vibing along my playlist 🎵, and watching good movies 🎬️. I thrive on learning, embracing every opportunity to dive deeper into the fascinating world of computer science. 🚀

Here, you’ll find a showcase of the apps I’ve built along my web development journey. Got feedback or spotted a bug? Don’t hesitate to share—I’m always eager to improve and grow!

Thanks for stopping by! ❤️

items.title: July 2026 - September 2026
